asset: Magisk daemon to manager/stub identity binding

trust_boundaries.attacker_control: package replacement is possible only after bypassing Android package-signature rules, changing install state, or modifying /data with elevated access
trust_boundaries.required_behavior: release daemon compares the extracted certificate to the certificate preserved from its embedded trusted stub and rejects mismatch

trust_boundaries.attacker_control: package and dynamic APK paths are writable only through app/root compromise or a defective recovery flow
trust_boundaries.required_behavior: bind the stored package, app ID, and certificate; reject changes and recover through the trusted stub
debug-only relaxation must never be compiled into a release artifact or presented as stable

abuse_cases: replace the normal manager with an untrusted certificate and request root policy UI authority
replace hidden-manager dyn/current.apk while retaining the expected package directory
change hidden package UID/certificate after the daemon caches it
ship a release with signature checks disabled through an unconditional compile-time constant

decisions.current_kitsune: global ENFORCE_SIGNATURE=0 is an acknowledged release blocker and must not be copied
decisions.next_system: preserve official stable default check-signature feature and release-only rejection paths
decisions.hidden_manager: permit no package-name-only exception; recovery remains certificate- and identity-bound
decisions.runtime_gate: PR6 must execute trusted install, untrusted replacement, hidden-manager replacement, and trusted-stub recovery on a disposable AVD
